name: AcoustID
description: Identifies albums by their sound when the tags don't say enough: each track's audio fingerprint is looked up on AcoustID, and the MusicBrainz releases holding the most of the album's tracks are offered in the album pane (Find details online…).

settings.label: AcoustID API key
settings.hint: Register an application at acoustid.org (free, with a MusicBrainz account) and paste its key, until bootleg has one of its own.

web.why: Fingerprinting reads the files, which a browser can't do.
